en-US.description: Upload one garment image, describe or mark the garment area, and pick a target color to generate clothing color changes with one click.
en-US.empty.bodyPart: Describe or mark which garment area to recolor
en-US.error.noModels: No AI model is currently available
en-US.error.noSize: The current model does not provide a usable size preset
en-US.error.references: The uploaded images do not contain usable reference identifiers
en-US.label: Clothing Color Change
en-US.maskPainter.help: Optionally paint over the garment area to recolor. When marked, the painted area takes priority and the garment area text is only used as semantic context.
en-US.drawer.title: Replace color
en-US.upload.modelImage.help: Upload one garment image, such as a real model, mannequin, flat-lay, hanging product, or product-only image. Only the specified garment area color will be replaced while preserving the original subject and non-target areas.

zh-CN.description: 上传单张服饰图，描述或标记需要换色的服饰部位，选择目标颜色，一键生成服饰换色图。
zh-CN.empty.modelImage: 请先上传 1 张服饰图
zh-CN.empty.bodyPart: 请描述或标记需要换色的服饰部位
zh-CN.error.noModels: 暂无可用 AI 模型
zh-CN.error.noSize: 当前模型缺少可用尺寸配置
zh-CN.error.references: 图片缺少可用于生成的资源标识
zh-CN.label: 服饰换色
zh-CN.maskPainter.help: 可在服饰图上涂抹需要换色的区域；标记后涂抹区域优先，换色部位仅作为语义补充。
zh-CN.drawer.title: 替换颜色
zh-CN.upload.modelImage.help: 上传单张服饰图，支持真人模特、人台、平铺、挂拍或商品图；仅替换指定服饰部位颜色，保留原图主体与其他区域。
zh-CN.bodyPart.placeholder: 如"上衣"、"裤装"、"外套"、"连衣裙"…
